input.body: We are writing to request a review of a $19.00 deduction on order DD-51131, dated 2026-11-06, which was taken with the reason "wrong item" for Chicken Momo (Steamed). The order ticket for DD-51131 lists 'Chicken Momo (Steamed)', which shows the item was prepared as placed [DD-51131:ticket_lists_item]. Our records also show the order was ready at 19:31 and picked up at 19:34, three minutes later [DD-51131:pickup_handoff]. We are not able to show what was in the bag after handoff, and we are only stating what the ticket and timestamps show. Based on this, we respectfully ask that the deduction be reviewed and, if the evidence supports it, reversed. Thank you for your time and consideration.
